description: Defines the RuntimeManagerHandler class and its nested RuntimeManagerNotification class, which manage runtime lifecycle events and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Manages runtime lifecycle operations and event handling for applications within the plugin.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Implements the INotification interface to handle runtime events such as start, terminate, failure, and state change notifications.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts or runs an application with specified parameters and target state.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes the application instance to a specified state.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for the application instance.
